description: A coarse dark olive knee-length tunic with a small laced opening at the collar, over ivory long sleeves. A large green-and-brown checked wool shoulder mantle with fringed edges is fastened by a round bronze ring brooch at one shoulder. A simple brown leather belt with a rectangular buckle and long hanging end holds the waist. Brown trousers, wrapped dark calf coverings and laced brown ankle boots complete the plain historical outfit. No armor or headgear.
